machine: Apple M1 Pro, 16 GB, macOS 27.0 (Darwin 27.0.0), Node 26.2.0, wrangler 4.135.0, vinext 1.1.0, Tailwind 4.3.3, Chrome 156.0.8078 headless through playwright-core 1.63.0
note: busyMs: the sum of non-idle CPU profile samples of the Worker isolate from Profiler.start before the request to Profiler.stop 300 ms after its body was read. Each sample owns timeDeltas[i], the time since the sample before it; a delta over 10 ms is a stretch with no sample while the isolate was parked, set aside in gapMs. Every request sends a Cookie header, which the shared page cache skips, so each one renders. Each run starts on a freshly started wrangler dev: one cold casa render, three warm-up rounds, then 15 measured rounds of sale, casa, essere. SEARCH_LIMIT in the built dist/server/wrangler.json was raised from 15 to 100000 a minute on both sides so the runs are not answered 429. Sizes: gzip level 6, brotli quality 4 and 11 (node:zlib).
